subject: Draft: Quiet-window liaison + escalation map for this year's review cycle
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Dawn Miller <dawn.miller@brightpathhr.com>
Cc: People Ops Shared <peopleops@brightpathhr.com>
Date: 2026-05-09T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quiet-window liaison + escalation map (draft)

Team —

As we finalize the annual review window, attaching an initial proposal for a "quiet-window" liaison and escalation map aimed at limiting privileged routing and reducing ad-hoc requests to managers. Key asks:

- Please confirm the primary liaison for each org cluster (I listed candidates in the matrix).
- Legal/InfoSec review: Dawn, can your team confirm whether we need additional redaction controls for shared artifacts?
- Ops: Karthik, can we reserve the two staging windows (7/12–7/16 and 7/19–7/23) for privileged access and manager calibrations?

Summary of approach in the sheet:
- Liaison = single point for escalation within each org (triages manager questions, coordinates redactions).
- Privileged artifacts (maps of calibration notes, raw manager comments) live in encrypted drive folder with access expiring after 90 days.
- Delegation flow: manager -> liaison -> People Ops -> Legal (if escalation).

I've attached: quiet-window-liaison-matrix.xlsx (role assignments) and an early manager-comm-template-v1.docx.

Please review and reply with edits or objections by EOD Tue (5/11). We need final owners by Wed so the People Ops ticket workflow can be configured.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Head of People Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: quiet-window-liaison-matrix.xlsx (spreadsheet), manager-comm-template-v1.docx (doc)
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Cc: Dawn Miller <dawn.miller@brightpathhr.com>, People Ops Shared <peopleops@brightpathhr.com>
Date: 2026-05-10T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quiet-window liaison + escalation map (draft)

Marissa —

Thanks, this is a solid start. A few quick notes from my side:

- Legal: we should route any redaction requests through Legal only when they involve exception-level data (passport/SSN equivalents). For manager comments we can use the standard redaction checklist and an attestation from the liaison. Dawn — can you confirm that is acceptable?
- Comms: the manager comm template needs a short FAQ block (3 bullets) that explicitly outlines what managers should not forward outside the liaison flow; that reduces accidental leakage.
- Timing: The two staging windows you propose are fine but I'm asking for a single blackout day (7/18) where we do not accept new calibration changes unless routed as an emergency. Helps reduce churn during finalization.

I made a couple inline edits in the manager comm doc (attached copy in Drive).

On the people manager side, I'll assign Laura B. (myself) to own the exec escalation lane; Marissa, can you own cross-org coordination?

Short replies ok here — we can finalize Wednesday.

—Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Talent Operations
Redwood Inference

Quick operational notes from infra/ops perspective:

- Staging windows OK but we need at least 24 hours notice to turn on elevated audit logging and temporary access roles. If liaisons can flag requests 24+ hours ahead we can automate permissions via the ticketing workflow.
- For the encrypted drive, we'll provision short-lived signed URLs and require MFA for download. That will add ~2–3 minutes to manager download times (FYI).
- If we expect >12 concurrent privileged accesses we should batch requests and throttle to avoid saturating the KV-cache replication for the audit store. Priyom, can you confirm expected peak concurrency?

I'll update the liaison matrix with an "ops note" column and push a new copy by EOD.

–Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Platform Reliability Lead, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Quiet-window liaison + escalation map (final owners and next steps)

Thanks all — consolidating and next steps below.

Final owners (confirmed):
- Liaison: Laura Bennett (Executive escalation lane)
- Cross-org coordinator: Marissa Cole (I will run the scheduling and owner handoffs)
- Ops SLA and access: Karthik Iyer (turn up audit logs and short-lived access)
- Vendor legal / redaction checklist: Dawn Miller (BrightPath)

Operational decisions:
- Staging windows: 2026-07-12 to 2026-07-16 (privileged prep), 2026-07-19 to 2026-07-23 (final calibrations). Blackout day: 2026-07-18.
- Access: 24-hour advance request required for elevated access; urgent flows will be accepted but must be justified and routed via liaison + People Ops ticket.
- Artifacts: encrypted Drive folder will be time-bound to 90 days; ops will generate signed download URLs.

I've uploaded the updated liaison matrix (quiet-window-liaison-matrix_v2.xlsx) and an edited manager comm template (manager-comm-template_v2.docx) to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1q2w3e_quiet-window

Action items:
- Laura: finalize the short FAQ and send to managers by 5/14.
- Karthik: post the ops note column and confirm throttling threshold by 5/12.
- Dawn: confirm the redaction checklist exception rules by 5/13.
- Priyom: prepare a 1-pager on peak concurrency expectations by 5/12.

If no objections by EOD Wed (5/13) I'll mark this as final and open the People Ops ticket flow to apply the access controls.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference
